description: Angular component HTML template for device management page in Thingsboard UI, including buttons, forms, and device details.

methods.name: onEntityAction
methods.description: Handles actions triggered by device management buttons, such as open, makePublic, assignToCustomer, etc.

methods.name: onDeviceIdCopied
methods.description: Handles copying device ID to clipboard.

methods.name: onDeviceProfileChanged
methods.description: Handles changes to device profile selection.

methods.name: hideDelete
methods.description: Determines if delete button should be hidden.

methods.name: isAssignedToCustomer
methods.description: Checks if the device is assigned to a customer.
